pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Numbers. The only path where power is measured in bodies rather than gear, and the only one that can hold ground in two places at once.

It denies you self-sufficiency. A leader without a retinue is the weakest thing in the room.

pages.title: The Bargain
pages.text:
Adventurers cannot die. They can only be broken.

Servants can die.

You are the only one who can send something ahead of you into the dark. On the Sealed Floor, where being broken is the whole cost, spending the expendable IS the power.

Whether that is noticed is not known.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. Gather GRAVE DUST from the restless dead.
2. Build toward a focus that raises a servant.
3. A retinue is upkeep. Do not raise more than you can hold.
4. Not every servant has to be dead - villagers can be hired and golems can be built.
